# RemoveAxis Trait Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Define `RemoveAxis` and implement it for `Ix0` through `Ix6` and `IxDyn` so axis-removing APIs can compute their output dimension type precisely.

**Architecture:** `RemoveAxis` lives with `Axis` in `src/dimension/axes.rs`; fixed-rank implementations live in `src/dimension/static.rs`; the dynamic implementation lives in `src/dimension/dynamic.rs`. `Ix0` remains a runtime-recoverable error case rather than a compile-time rejection.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, std

**Design Docs:** `design/02-dimension.md` §5.6 (RemoveAxis), `design/02-dimension.md` §10 (error semantics), `design/26-error.md` §4.2 (InvalidAxis payload)

**Prerequisites:** W3T4 must be complete.

```rust
use crate::error::XenonError;

use super::Dimension;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
#[repr(transparent)]
pub struct Axis(pub usize);

impl Axis {
    #[inline]
    pub fn new(axis: usize) -> Self { Axis(axis) }
    #[inline]
    pub fn index(self) -> usize { self.0 }
    #[inline]
    pub fn checked_next(self) -> Option<Self> { self.0.checked_add(1).map(Axis) }
    #[inline]
    pub fn next(self) -> Self { Axis(self.0.checked_add(1).expect("Axis::next overflow")) }
    #[inline]
    pub fn prev(self) -> Option<Self> { self.0.checked_sub(1).map(Axis) }
    #[inline]
    pub fn is_first(self) -> bool { self.0 == 0 }
    #[inline]
    pub fn is_last(self, ndim: usize) -> bool { ndim > 0 && self.0 == ndim - 1 }
}

pub trait RemoveAxis: Dimension {
    type Smaller: Dimension;

    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<Self::Smaller, XenonError>;
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use crate::dimension::{Dimension, Ix0, Ix1, Ix2, Ix3, IxDyn};
    use crate::error::XenonError;

    use super::{Axis, RemoveAxis};

    #[test]
    fn test_ix0_remove_axis_invalid() {
        let err = Ix0.remove_axis(Axis(0)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(
            err,
            XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation, axis: 0, ndim: 0, shape } if operation == "RemoveAxis::remove_axis" && shape.is_empty()
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix1_remove_axis_success() {
        assert_eq!(Ix1(4).remove_axis(Axis(0)).unwrap(), Ix0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix2_remove_axis_each_position() {
        assert_eq!(Ix2(2, 3).remove_axis(Axis(0)).unwrap(), Ix1(3));
        assert_eq!(Ix2(2, 3).remove_axis(Axis(1)).unwrap(), Ix1(2));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ix3_remove_axis_each_position() {
        assert_eq!(Ix3(2, 3, 4).remove_axis(Axis(0)).unwrap(), Ix2(3, 4));
        assert_eq!(Ix3(2, 3, 4).remove_axis(Axis(1)).unwrap(), Ix2(2, 4));
        assert_eq!(Ix3(2, 3, 4).remove_axis(Axis(2)).unwrap(), Ix2(2, 3));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_ixdyn_remove_axis_success() {
        let dim = IxDyn::from_vec(vec![2, 3, 4]).remove_axis(Axis(1)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(dim.slice(), &[2, 4]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_remove_axis_invalid_axis_error() {
        let err = Ix2(2, 3).remove_axis(Axis(4)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(
            err,
            XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation, axis: 4, ndim: 2, shape } if operation == "RemoveAxis::remove_axis" && shape == vec![2, 3]
        ));
    }
}
```

```rust
use crate::error::XenonError;
use crate::private::Sealed;

use super::{Axis, Dimension, IxDyn, RemoveAxis};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix0;

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix1(pub usize);

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix2(pub usize, pub usize);

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix3(pub usize, pub usize, pub usize);

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix4(pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize);

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix5(pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize);

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Ix6(pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize, pub usize);

impl Sealed for Ix0 {}
impl Sealed for Ix1 {}
impl Sealed for Ix2 {}
impl Sealed for Ix3 {}
impl Sealed for Ix4 {}
impl Sealed for Ix5 {}
impl Sealed for Ix6 {}

impl Dimension for Ix0 {
    const NDIM: Option<usize> = Some(0);
    fn ndim(&self) -> usize { 0 }
    fn slice(&self) -> &[usize] { &[] }
    fn checked_size(&self) -> Result<usize, XenonError> { Ok(1) }
    fn checked(&self) -> Result<(), XenonError> { Ok(()) }
    fn into_dyn(self) -> IxDyn { IxDyn::new() }
    fn try_from_dyn(dyn_dim: IxDyn) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
        if dyn_dim.ndim() == 0 { Ok(Ix0) } else { Err(XenonError::DimensionMismatch { operation: "Dimension::try_from_dyn".into(), expected: 0, actual: dyn_dim.ndim() }) }
    }
    fn try_from_slice(slice: &[usize]) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
        if slice.is_empty() { Ok(Ix0) } else { Err(XenonError::DimensionMismatch { operation: "Dimension::try_from_slice".into(), expected: 0, actual: slice.len() }) }
    }
}

macro_rules! static_dimension {
    ($name:ident, $n:expr, [$($field:tt),+], [$($from:expr),+]) => {
        impl Dimension for $name {
            const NDIM: Option<usize> = Some($n);
            fn ndim(&self) -> usize { $n }
            fn slice(&self) -> &[usize] {
                unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts(self as *const Self as *const usize, $n) }
            }
            fn checked_size(&self) -> Result<usize, XenonError> {
                let dims = [$($(self.$field)),+];
                let mut acc = 1usize;
                for (axis, &dim) in dims.iter().enumerate() {
                    let previous = acc;
                    acc = acc.checked_mul(dim).ok_or(XenonError::InvalidShape {
                        operation: "Dimension::checked_size".into(),
                        shape: dims.into(),
                        expected_elements: previous,
                        actual_elements: dim,
                        offending_dim: Some(axis),
                        reason: Some("element count overflow".into()),
                    })?;
                }
                Ok(acc)
            }
            fn checked(&self) -> Result<(), XenonError> { self.checked_size().map(|_| ()) }
            fn into_dyn(self) -> IxDyn { IxDyn::from_vec(vec![$($(self.$field)),+]) }
            fn try_from_dyn(dyn_dim: IxDyn) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
                if dyn_dim.ndim() == $n {
                    let s = dyn_dim.slice();
                    Ok($name($($from(s)),+))
                } else {
                    Err(XenonError::DimensionMismatch { operation: "Dimension::try_from_dyn".into(), expected: $n, actual: dyn_dim.ndim() })
                }
            }
            fn try_from_slice(slice: &[usize]) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
                if slice.len() == $n {
                    Ok($name($($from(slice)),+))
                } else {
                    Err(XenonError::DimensionMismatch { operation: "Dimension::try_from_slice".into(), expected: $n, actual: slice.len() })
                }
            }
        }
    };
}

static_dimension!(Ix1, 1, [0], [|s: &[usize]| s[0]]);
static_dimension!(Ix2, 2, [0, 1], [|s: &[usize]| s[0], |s: &[usize]| s[1]]);
static_dimension!(Ix3, 3, [0, 1, 2], [|s: &[usize]| s[0], |s: &[usize]| s[1], |s: &[usize]| s[2]]);
static_dimension!(Ix4, 4, [0, 1, 2, 3], [|s: &[usize]| s[0], |s: &[usize]| s[1], |s: &[usize]| s[2], |s: &[usize]| s[3]]);
static_dimension!(Ix5, 5, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], [|s: &[usize]| s[0], |s: &[usize]| s[1], |s: &[usize]| s[2], |s: &[usize]| s[3], |s: &[usize]| s[4]]);
static_dimension!(Ix6, 6, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [|s: &[usize]| s[0], |s: &[usize]| s[1], |s: &[usize]| s[2], |s: &[usize]| s[3], |s: &[usize]| s[4], |s: &[usize]| s[5]]);

impl RemoveAxis for Ix0 {
    type Smaller = Ix0;
    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<Ix0, XenonError> {
        Err(XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation: "RemoveAxis::remove_axis".into(), axis: axis.index(), ndim: 0, shape: self.slice().into() })
    }
}

impl RemoveAxis for Ix1 {
    type Smaller = Ix0;
    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<Ix0, XenonError> {
        if axis.index() < 1 { Ok(Ix0) } else { Err(XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation: "RemoveAxis::remove_axis".into(), axis: axis.index(), ndim: 1, shape: self.slice().into() }) }
    }
}

impl RemoveAxis for Ix2 {
    type Smaller = Ix1;
    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<Ix1, XenonError> {
        match axis.index() {
            0 => Ok(Ix1(self.1)),
            1 => Ok(Ix1(self.0)),
            _ => Err(XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation: "RemoveAxis::remove_axis".into(), axis: axis.index(), ndim: 2, shape: self.slice().into() }),
        }
    }
}

impl RemoveAxis for Ix3 {
    type Smaller = Ix2;
    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<Ix2, XenonError> {
        match axis.index() {
            0 => Ok(Ix2(self.1, self.2)),
            1 => Ok(Ix2(self.0, self.2)),
            2 => Ok(Ix2(self.0, self.1)),
            _ => Err(XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation: "RemoveAxis::remove_axis".into(), axis: axis.index(), ndim: 3, shape: self.slice().into() }),
        }
    }
}

impl RemoveAxis for Ix4 {
    type Smaller = Ix3;
    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<Ix3, XenonError> {
        match axis.index() {
            0 => Ok(Ix3(self.1, self.2, self.3)),
            1 => Ok(Ix3(self.0, self.2, self.3)),
            2 => Ok(Ix3(self.0, self.1, self.3)),
            3 => Ok(Ix3(self.0, self.1, self.2)),
            _ => Err(XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation: "RemoveAxis::remove_axis".into(), axis: axis.index(), ndim: 4, shape: self.slice().into() }),
        }
    }
}

impl RemoveAxis for Ix5 {
    type Smaller = Ix4;
    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<Ix4, XenonError> {
        match axis.index() {
            0 => Ok(Ix4(self.1, self.2, self.3, self.4)),
            1 => Ok(Ix4(self.0, self.2, self.3, self.4)),
            2 => Ok(Ix4(self.0, self.1, self.3, self.4)),
            3 => Ok(Ix4(self.0, self.1, self.2, self.4)),
            4 => Ok(Ix4(self.0, self.1, self.2, self.3)),
            _ => Err(XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation: "RemoveAxis::remove_axis".into(), axis: axis.index(), ndim: 5, shape: self.slice().into() }),
        }
    }
}

impl RemoveAxis for Ix6 {
    type Smaller = Ix5;
    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: Axis) -> Result<Ix5, XenonError> {
        match axis.index() {
            0 => Ok(Ix5(self.1, self.2, self.3, self.4, self.5)),
            1 => Ok(Ix5(self.0, self.2, self.3, self.4, self.5)),
            2 => Ok(Ix5(self.0, self.1, self.3, self.4, self.5)),
            3 => Ok(Ix5(self.0, self.1, self.2, self.4, self.5)),
            4 => Ok(Ix5(self.0, self.1, self.2, self.3, self.5)),
            5 => Ok(Ix5(self.0, self.1, self.2, self.3, self.4)),
            _ => Err(XenonError::InvalidAxis { operation: "RemoveAxis::remove_axis".into(), axis: axis.index(), ndim: 6, shape: self.slice().into() }),
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the complete `dynamic.rs` file with the dynamic `RemoveAxis` impl**

Append the following implementation to `src/dimension/dynamic.rs` just before the test module:

```rust
impl super::RemoveAxis for IxDyn {
    type Smaller = IxDyn;

    fn remove_axis(&self, axis: super::Axis) -> Result<IxDyn, XenonError> {
        if axis.index() >= self.ndim() {
            return Err(XenonError::InvalidAxis {
                operation: "RemoveAxis::remove_axis".into(),
                axis: axis.index(),
                ndim: self.ndim(),
                shape: self.slice().into(),
            });
        }

        let mut dims = self.dims.clone();
        dims.remove(axis.index());
        Ok(IxDyn { dims })
    }
}
```
